subject: Diesel surcharge per clause 7.2
body: Dear Deccan Fresh team, as per clause 7.2 of our supply agreement, a diesel surcharge of up to 2.5% over PO price will be applied whenever HSD prices rise above Rs 92/litre. Any increase beyond this will be discussed with procurement in advance.

subject: Billing unit
body: Our ERP raises all invoices in quintals. Kindly convert at 1 QTL = 100 KG for matching.

subject: Cash discount offer
body: We are extending 2% cash discount on all invoices paid within 10 days (2/10 Net 45).

subject: Loading/handling
body: Labour loading and handling for each pull is billed at actuals on the storage invoice.

subject: Advisory: invoice fraud in the region
body: Several Hyderabad FMCG companies received fake 'change of bank account' letters this quarter. Never act on a bank change without a call-back to the number in the vendor master.
